The outer rectangular boundary represents the universal set U. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.

A rectangular Venn diagram representing three intersecting sets A, B, and C within a universal set U. Three large circles A, B, and C overlap, resembling a three-leaf clover, creating 8 distinct regions. The top left circle is A, top right is B, bottom center is C. The regions are clearly marked: 'Only A', 'Only B', 'Only C', 'A and B only', 'A and C only', 'B and C only', 'All three (A ∩ B ∩ C)', and the outside area '(A ∪ B ∪ C)''.
